title: Link Proximity Snap Strict Inner Disk
description: Fix board link drag so drops on target node body use indirectConnect / LinkTargetNode when snap tolerance equals rim distance (circle nodes with opposite handles). Change nearest_link_snap_handle_world from d <= tol to d < tol.
summary: Proximity snap used inclusive distance d <= tol. For default circle nodes (r=40) and handle tolerance (~40 world), the target node center sits exactly on the snap ring, so nearest_link_snap_handle_world returned a handle and pointer_up committed via proximityConnect instead of indirectConnect / LinkTargetNode. Switched the snap test to strict d < tol so node-center drops stay unsnapped and the existing indirect-link tests pass. Verified: cargo test -p elements_board --lib (50 passed).
